quest.title: Cat and Cog
quest.description: Go to the Curatorium of Secrets, place your tea table, and have Sandrone take a seat. Then, prepare to enjoy some tea with Nefer...

talks.objective: Go to the Curatorium of Secrets to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Mm, delicious tea and delectable snacks. Thank you for your hospitality, Miss Sandrone.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I'm glad you like it. I also brought some snacks for Ashru. Isn't that right, Ashru? Come here. There's a good kitty.

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow~

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I hope your warm feelings for Nod-Krai and the Curatorium of Secrets will prove beneficial to our future cooperation.

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: I hope so too. Here, Ashru, try one of these.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Also, regarding that matter I enquired about before...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Hehe, your little paws are so soft...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Miss Sandrone... Don't tell me you used this tea party as a pretext to come here and dote on my cat?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Huh...? M—Me? I would never! I take my dealings with the Curatorium of Secrets very seriously!

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Ashru, come here.

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow~

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Aww...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Then let's talk about the details of our "dealings," shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: ...Hmph. S—So what if I wanted to pet Ashru... Who wouldn't!?

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Small animals are usually wary of machines. It took a lot of work to get Ashru to trust me when I was here working on the numerological array. What's so wrong with me wanting to give him a belly rub or two...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Hah... No need to get so defensive.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Go on, Ashru. It's not like it's my place to tell you who you can or can't rub up against.

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow~

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: But once you're done petting him, don't forget we have business to discuss...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: Like I told you, I take our dealings very seriously!

talks.objective: Go to the Curatorium of Secrets to start the tea party

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Tea tastes so much better when paired with useful intel...

dialogues.speaker: Marionette
dialogues.text: (Let's sit like this for a little while longer.)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Oh, take care. And remember to drop by whenever you're free.
